## CatGo 1.4.6

### License change in 1.4.6

CatGo 1.4.6 distributions use the **source-available CatGo Noncommercial Research License 1.0**. This is not an open-source license. Commercial use
requires prior written permission; see
[COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md](https://github.com/Hello-QM/catgo-LRG/blob/main/COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md)
or contact `gul026@ucsd.edu`.

Every public output must include this exact acknowledgement:

> This work used CatGo (https://catgo-ucsd.org).

It must also cite DOI
[`10.26434/chemrxiv.15002984/v1`](https://doi.org/10.26434/chemrxiv.15002984/v1).
Third-party materials retain their own terms.

Copies of historical CatGo releases already distributed under AGPL remain
governed by those grants; those AGPL permissions are **not revoked**.

### Downloads

- **Windows** — `.msi` or `-setup.exe`
- **macOS** — `.dmg` for Apple Silicon
- **Linux** — `.deb` or `.rpm`
- **Android** — `CatGo-v*-android-universal.apk`
- **iOS** — [TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/FdHup5Hz)

See the
[CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Hello-QM/catgo-LRG/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete release history.
